# MarketForge YouTube Strategy

Apply V3 §3.6.

## Global quality rules

- Well-made tutorial earns views 3-5 years (highest compounding video channel).
- Production cost: $2-10K per video at T2 quality; $300-1K at T1 with iPhone + decent mic.
- Track assisted conversions, not last-click.
- AI-automatable for production support; AI-narrated full videos detected and underperform.

## Purpose

1. Format decision (long-form tutorial / Shorts / livestream / hybrid).
2. Topic strategy (ICP-specific "how to do X" + product demos + founder explainers).
3. Production tier (iPhone-DIY vs studio).
4. SEO + Shorts optimization.
5. Attribution discipline.

## Inputs
- `channel-strategy.md`, `icp-and-personas/`, `content-strategy.md`, `competitive-intel.md`.

## Outputs
- `docs/marketing-plan/07-organic-social/youtube-strategy.md`
- DEC-428 to DEC-433

## Structure

```markdown
# YouTube Strategy

## Format mix

### Long-form tutorials (10-30 min)
- Highest compound. ICP-specific "how to do [task]" content.
- SEO benefit: video SERP positioning.
- Examples: "How to [common task in our category]" / "[Customer use case] walkthrough."

### Founder explainers (5-15 min)
- POV pieces, behind-the-scenes, category direction.
- Audience-building.

### Product demos (3-8 min)
- Step-by-step product walkthrough.
- Bottom-funnel content.

### Shorts (15-60 sec)
- Repurposed from longer content.
- Reach-building, less direct attribution.
- Vertical 9:16.

### Livestreams
- Optional for high-touch dev tools / community-engaged products.

## Production tier

| Tier | Setup | Cost/video |
|---|---|---|
| T1 | iPhone + lavalier mic ($30) + free editing | $0 (founder time) |
| T2 | Mirrorless camera + decent mic + Premiere/DaVinci | $300-1K |
| T3 | Studio setup + editor contractor | $2-10K |

Don't over-invest before format proves. Many successful YouTubers iPhone-shot for first 12+ months.

## SEO optimization

- Title: specific, includes target query.
- Description: 200+ words, includes target query + variations + relevant timestamps + links.
- Thumbnail: high-contrast, face if applicable, clear at 320px.
- Tags: relevant, sparse, NOT keyword-stuffed.
- Chapters: time-stamped (improves retention + Google video schema).
- Closed captions: required (a11y + SEO).

## Shorts optimization

- 9:16 vertical.
- First 1-2 seconds decisive.
- Captions burned in (most muted).
- Hook visible in feed preview.

## Topic strategy

### Long-form
- ICP-specific tasks (high-intent search queries).
- Comparison content (us vs competitor walkthrough).
- "How we built [X]" engineering content (dev tools).
- Customer case study deep-dives.

### Founder explainers
- Category POV.
- "Why we built [X] differently."
- Behind-the-scenes decisions.

### Shorts
- Repurposed from long-form highlights.
- Quick tips from product expertise.

## Attribution

- Assisted conversions in GA4 (YouTube referrals).
- Self-report survey at conversion ("How did you hear about us?").
- YouTube Studio analytics for retention curves.
- Watch time + comments as engagement signal (not vanity).

## Decision cards
[DEC-428 to DEC-433]

## Kill criteria
- 6-12 months; subscriber growth flat + no assisted-conversion signal + no inbound mentions → re-evaluate format / topic.

## What we are intentionally NOT doing
- AI-narrated full-length videos (detected, underperform).
- Generic "B-roll + voiceover" thought leadership.
- Buying subscribers / views.
- Misleading thumbnails / titles (kills channel via low retention).

## Sources and basis
V3 §3.6.
```
